titleEn: Financial Institutions – Merchandise, Services, and Debt Repayment
descriptionEn: This MCC must be used by Financial Institutions for the purchase of merchandise or services or the repayment of loans & debts. “Financial Institution” includes banks, savings and loans, thrifts, and credit unions . For example: the purchase of checks, other financial products, or promotional merchandise, deposits, the funding of an account (which must be processed as Account Funding Transaction), the purchase or reload of a stored value card , the purchase of foreign currency, Liquid and Cryptocurrency Assets (for example: cryptocurrency), money orders (a negotiable paper-based remittance – not a Money Transfer), travelers cheques, and loan fees or financial counseling service fees. This MCC must also be used for the repayment of a debt, loan, or credit card balance by a cardholder to the financial institution. A Financial Institution that sells Liquid and Cryptocurrency Assets such as cryptocurrency must include all required data in the authorization request and clearing record.
includedEn: Purchase of Foreign currency Liquid and
Cryptocurrency Assets (for example, cryptocurrency), money orders (Not Money

titleEn: Non-Financial Institutions – Foreign Currency, Liquid and Cryptocurrency Assets (for example: Cryptocurrency), Money
descriptionEn: Orders (Not Money Transfer), Account Funding (not Stored Value Load), Travelers Cheques, and Debt Repayment This MCC must be used for the funding of an account (excluding prepaid card loads), the purchase of foreign currency, Liquid and Cryptocurrency Assets (for example: cryptocurrency), money orders, or travelers’ cheques that occurs at non-Financial Institutions such as currency exchanges or money order (a negotiable paper-based remittance – not a Money Transfer) Merchants. This MCC must also be used for the repayment of a loan or debt if the entity that holds the debt is not a financial institution. A Merchant that sells Liquid and Cryptocurrency Assets such as cryptocurrency must include all required data in the authorization request and clearing record. All other transactions at the same Merchant location must use the appropriate MCC for those transactions.
Merchants classified with this MCC are licensed, in all jurisdictions they sell into to buy, sell and broker securities, stocks, bonds, commodities, and mutual funds.

Merchants classified with this MCC sell personal or business insurance policies such as automobile, life, health, hospital, medical, and dental insurance, homeowners’ and renters’ insurance, real estate title insurance, pet health insurance and flood, fire, or earthquake insurance.

This MCC must be used for the payment of management fees, rental commissions, rental payments, and other payments at real estate agents, brokers, and managers engaged in the rental and management of residential and commercial properties. This MCC should also be used for payments of deposits for real estate purchases. Short term rentals (of less than one month) must be included in MCC 7011 Lodging – Hotels, Motels, Resorts, Central Reservation Services (Not Elsewhere Classified) or, if appropriate, the Merchant’s MCC. This MCC does not include mortgage loan payments and real estate purchases. These transactions must be identified with a more appropriate MCC such as MCC 6012 Financial Institutions – Merchandise and Services; MCC 1520 General Contractors; MCC 8111 Legal Services and Attorneys.

titleEn: Non-Financial Institutions – Stored Value Card Purchase/Load
descriptionEn: This MCC must be used by Merchants whose primary business is the sale of and/or any subsequent reloads of stored value cards/accounts (including Visa Prepaid Cards) occurring at non-financial institutions. This MCC is not applicable for use with Staged Digital Wallet Operators (SDWO).

titleEn: Lodging – Hotels, Motels, Resorts, Central Reservation Services (Not Elsewhere Classified)
descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC are lodging establishments or central reservation services that do not have their own specific MCC. MCC 7011 may include bed and breakfast establishments, resorts, cabins, cottages, hostels, short-term property rentals less than 30 days in length, and local inns.
Merchants classified with this MCC sell, lease, and rent timeshares and arrange timeshare condominium exchanges.
Merchants classified with this MCC operate children’s camps, recreational camps, and sporting camps.
Merchants classified with this MCC provide overnight or short-term camp sites for recreational vehicles, trailers, campers, or tents.
Merchants classified with this MCC operate steam or other types of laundry or laundry services.
Merchants classified with this MCC provide coin-operated or similar self-service washers and dryers for general consumer use and may also offer laundry services.
Merchants classified with this MCC perform dry cleaning services for individuals or businesses and may offer limited alteration services.

descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC clean carpets, drapes, and upholstery.
Merchants classified with this MCC perform still or video portrait photography for the general public.

Merchants classified with this MCC provide personal hair care services such as hair cutting, styling, and coloring, and may also perform manicures and pedicures and sell a limited selection of hair care products.

titleEn: Shoe Repair Shops, Shoeshine Parlors, and Hat Cleaning Shops
descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC repair footwear and provide shoe and hat cleaning and maintenance services.
Merchants classified with this MCC are mortuaries, crematories, and funeral homes that provide burial preparation services, conduct funerals, and provide cremation services.
Merchants classified with this MCC provide dating and escort services, including online services.
Merchants classified with this MCC provide income tax return preparation services but do not provide auditing, accounting, or bookkeeping services.

titleEn: Counseling Services – Debt, Marriage, and Personal
descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC provide a variety of personal counseling services, such as debt and financial counseling, marriage counseling, family counseling, and alcohol and drug abuse counseling.

titleEn: Buying and Shopping Services and Clubs
descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC act as an intermediary to facilitate buying and shopping for individuals or businesses on a fee basis.

titleEn: Clothing Rental – Costumes, Uniforms, Formal Wear
descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC rent costumes, uniforms, formal wear, and other types of apparel and related accessories.
Merchants classified with this MCC specialize in providing therapeutic massage services and may also provide other personal services such as spa.

Merchants classified with this MCC provide a variety of personal or therapeutic services such as facials, massages, mud baths, herbal wraps, tanning treatments, whirlpools, steam baths, hair and makeup styling, and instructional classes.
Merchants classified with this MCC provide personal services that are not classified with a more specific MCC.

Merchants classified with this MCC prepare advertising (writing copy, artwork, graphics, and other creative work) and place such advertising and/or samples in periodicals, newspapers, radio and television, on the internet, in the sky, or other advertising media for clients on a contract or fee basis.
Merchants classified with this MCC provide consumer credit reporting services such as credit investigation, credit clearinghouses, and other related services.

Merchants classified with this MCC provide commercial art or graphic design services for advertising agencies, publishers, and other businesses.

titleEn: Quick Copy, Reproduction, and Blueprinting Services
descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC reproduce and bind text, drawings, plans, maps, or other copy, by blueprinting, photocopying, or other methods of duplication.

Merchants classified with this MCC provide a range of stenographic and secretarial services such as word processing, typing, editing, letter writing, proofreading, resume writing, and court reporting services.

Merchants classified with this MCC provide cleaning and maintenance services.

descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC provide employment services for those seeking employees or employment.

titleEn: Computer Programming, Data Processing, and Integrated Systems Design Services
descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC provide computer programming services, systems design, website design, data entry, and data processing services.
Merchants classified with this MCC are business-to-business or wholesale provisioners of online or database information retrieval services.

titleEn: Computer Maintenance, Repair and Services (Not Elsewhere Classified)
descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC provide computer-related services such as computer consulting, database development, computer maintenance and repair, conversion services, and computer requirements analysis.

titleEn: Management, Consulting, and Public Relations Services
descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC perform a variety of activities for private, nonprofit, and public organizations, such as strategic and organizational planning, financial planning and budgeting, developing marketing objectives, information systems planning, development of human resource policies, and public relations services.

titleEn: Detective Agencies, Protective Services, and Security Services, including Armored Cars, and Guard Dogs
descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC provide security devices/systems and services such as security guard,.

titleEn: Equipment, Tool, Furniture, and Appliance Rental and Leasing
descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC rent and lease equipment, tools, furniture, appliances, and office equipment, excluding typewriters.
Merchants classified with this MCC develop film, make photographic prints and enlargements, provide custom services, and may also sell a limited selection of photographic supplies and accessories.
Merchants classified with this MCC provide business services that are not typically considered to be “professions” and are not classified with a more specific MCC.
Merchants classified with this MCC are car rental agencies that do not have designated unique MCCs.

Car Rentals 7513 – Truck and Utility Trailer

titleEn: Motor Home and Recreational Vehicle Rentals
descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC rent motor homes, RVs, campers, tent trailers, and other recreational vehicles on daily, short-term, or extended-term basis.

titleEn: Parking Lots, Parking Meters and Garages
descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC provide temporary parking services for all modes of transportation, usually on an hourly, daily, or monthly contract or fee basis.
Merchants classified with this MCC perform automotive body repair work and may paint automobiles in conjunction with body repair work.
Merchants classified with this MCC sell, install, repair, or retread old tires.
Merchants classified with this MCC paint, refinish, and restore automobiles.

descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC conduct automotive repairs and general or specific services.

Merchants classified with this MCC provide vehicle towing services.
Merchants classified with this MCC repair electronics (excluding appliances) such as radios, televisions, stereo equipment, and computers.

titleEn: Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Repair Shops
descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC service and repair household and commercial air conditioning and refrigeration systems.

titleEn: Electrical and Small Appliance Repair Shops
descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC service and repair household and commercial electrical components, small appliances (such as microwaves, toaster ovens, and toasters), and electrical office machines, excluding typewriters.
includedEn: Repairs – Office Machines 5978 – Typewriter Stores – Sales

descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC clean and repair all types of watches, clocks, and fine jewelry.
Merchants classified with this MCC reupholster, repair, refinish, and restore furniture.
Merchants classified with this MCC perform welding services and repair.

titleEn: Miscellaneous Repair Shops and Related Services
descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC provide service and repair work and are not classified with a more specific MCC.
Merchants classified with this MCC are government-owned lotteries in the US Region that are registered with Visa to sell lottery tickets.

titleEn: Government Licensed On-Line Casinos (On-Line Gambling) (US Region only)
descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC are licensed by a US government entity (and/or sanctioned and regulated by applicable legislation) and registered with Visa to sell virtual gambling chips or offer online gambling.

Merchants classified with this MCC are licensed by a US government entity (and/or sanctioned and regulated by applicable legislation) and registered with Visa to sell on-or off-track wagers at horse-or dog-racing facilities.

titleEn: Motion Picture and Video Tape Production and Distribution
descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC are business-to-business or wholesale producers and distributors of educational and industrial films and videos for exhibition and sale.
Merchants classified with this MCC operate movie theaters and sell tickets and refreshments or sell movie tickets online.
Merchants classified with this MCC rent DVDs/video tapes for personal use and may sell a limited selection of used videos/DVDs and refreshments.
Merchants classified with this MCC operate dance studios, schools, and public dance halls or ballrooms.

titleEn: Ticket Agencies and Theatrical Producers (Except Motion Pictures)
descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC operate live theatrical productions (such as road companies and summer theater groups) and services associated with theatrical productions and concerts (such as casting agencies, booking agencies, scenery, lighting, and other equipment services, and theatrical ticket agencies).

titleEn: Bands, Orchestras, and Miscellaneous Entertainers (Not Elsewhere Classified)
descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC provide entertainment other than theatrical productions (such as musicians, bands, orchestras, and other types of entertainers such as comedians and magicians).
Merchants classified with this MCC operate establishments that rent the use of pool or billiard tables and other games for entertainment.
Merchants classified with this MCC operate bowling alleys for entertainment.

titleEn: Commercial Sports, Professional Sports Clubs, Athletic Fields, and Sports Promoters
descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC operate and promote semi-professional and professional athletic clubs (such as baseball, basketball, football, hockey, soccer), promote amateur and professional athletic events, manage individual athletes, and manage sports arenas and stadiums.
Merchants classified with this MCC operate a variety of tourist attractions and exhibits for entertainment, such as botanical gardens, craft shows, museums, and wineries.
Merchants classified with this MCC operate public golf courses.
Merchants classified with this MCC sell coin-operated amusement machines such as video game machines,.

Merchants classified with this MCC operate arcades, amusement machines (such as video game machines, jukeboxes, pinball machines, mechanical games, instant photograph booths, and similar types of amusement equipment) and indoor playgrounds.
includedEn: Social casinos not offering any prizes of monetary value

titleEn: Betting, including Lottery Tickets, Casino Gaming Chips, Off-Track Betting, Wagers at Race Tracks and games of chance to
descriptionEn: win prizes of monetary value Merchants classified with this MCC operate games of chance to win prizes of monetary value or betting establishments. Merchants that are unable to distinguish a betting transaction from other transactions must identify all transactions with MCC 7995.

titleEn: Amusement Parks, Circuses, Carnivals, and Fortune Tellers
descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC operate circuses, carnivals, and amusement and theme parks that offer mechanical rides, snacks and food stands, games, animal exhibits, and entertainment, as well as fortune-telling, astrology, mystic, and tarot card-reading services.

titleEn: Membership Clubs (Sports, Recreation, Athletic), Country Clubs, and Private Golf Courses
descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC operate sports and recreation facilities that require membership such as exercise, athletic and health clubs, country clubs, private golf courses, boating and yacht clubs, swimming clubs, tennis clubs, bowling leagues, riding clubs, shooting and gun clubs, and racquetball clubs, and may also provide spa services.
Merchants classified with this MCC operate zoos or sea life parks for entertainment and education for the general public.
includedEn: Sea Life Parks 7991 – Tourist Attractions and

descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC provide a wide variety of recreation and entertainment services that require active physical participation and that are not classified with a more specific MCC.
Merchants classified with this MCC are licensed physicians engaged in a practice of general or specialized medicine and surgery that is not classified with a more specific MCC.
Merchants classified with this MCC are licensed physicians that practice general or specialized dentistry such as dental surgery.
Merchants classified with this MCC provide therapy involving the non-surgical manipulation and adjustment of bone structures.
Merchants classified with this MCC provide therapy in which the spinal column and limbs are manipulated or adjusted.

Merchants classified with this MCC are licensed physicians that examine and treat eye defects with corrective eyeglasses or contacts or surgical techniques, treat eye diseases, and may fill contact or eyeglass prescriptions and sell eyeglass frames.
Merchants classified with this MCC perform eye examinations, write prescriptions, make and sell eyeglasses, and sell other optical goods.
includedEn: Eyeglass Stores 8011 – Doctors and Physicians (Not Elsewhere Classified)

descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC are licensed physicians specializing in diagnosing and treating foot ailments.

titleEn: Nursing, Home Healthcare and Personal Care Facilities
descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC provide inpatient nursing or health-related personal care services and operate convalescent/nursing homes, hospice facilities, offer care in home/residential environment and other long-term care facilities that generally do not offer surgery.

Merchants classified with this MCC are hospitals that provide diagnostic services, extensive medical treatment, surgery, continuous nursing services, mental and psychiatric care, and other hospital services.
Merchants classified with this MCC provide medical and dental laboratory services.

titleEn: Medical Services and Health Practitioners (Not Elsewhere Classified)
descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC are medical professionals that are not classified with a more specific MCC.
Merchants classified with this MCC are headed by members of the bar and provide legal advice and services.
Merchants classified with this MCC are elementary and secondary schools that provide academic instruction.

titleEn: Colleges, Universities, Professional Schools, and Junior Colleges
descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC are community and junior colleges, universities, theological seminaries and professional schools (such as dental, law, engineering, medical) that provide academic courses and grant academic degrees.
Merchants classified with this MCC are correspondence schools that offer educational and instruction through the mail/internet by sending lessons and examinations to the student.
Merchants classified with this MCC are business and secretarial schools that offer general business training such as office procedures, word processing, stenographic, and other clerical skills.
includedEn: Computer Training 8249 – Vocational and Trade Schools

descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC offer training and instruction in specialized professions such as welding, mechanics, carpentry, real estate, and truck driving.

titleEn: Schools and Educational Services (Not Elsewhere Classified)
descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC offer educational courses and services that are not classified with a more specific MCC.
Merchants classified with this MCC provide care for infants or children.

Merchants classified with this MCC are non-political fund-raising organizations engaged in soliciting charitable donations/contributions on behalf of organizations engaged in social welfare services, or social service organizations engaged in social welfare services. This MCC also includes crowd funding Merchants that accept donations on behalf of individuals raising money for various causes without receiving any perceived or actual financial benefit for doing so.
Merchants classified with this MCC are associations engaged in civic, social, or fraternal activities.
Merchants classified with this MCC are membership organizations that promote the interests of or raise funds for a national, state, or local political party or candidate.
Merchants classified with this MCC are religious organizations that provide worship services, religious training or study, or religious activities.
Merchants classified with this MCC are automobile associations and clubs that provide a variety of travel-related services to its members.
includedEn: Automobile Club 8699 – Membership Organizations (Not Elsewhere Classified)

descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC are organizations or associations that are not classified with a more specific MCC.

Merchants classified with this MCC provide testing services (such as automobile testing, calibration and certification, food testing, forensic testing, product and pollution testing, and industrial X-ray inspection services).
Merchants classified with this MCC provide professional architectural, home and building design, boat design, and engineering, land, water, and aerial surveying services.
Merchants classified with this MCC provide accounting, bookkeeping, billing and payroll services, and other related auditing services, and may also provide income tax preparation services.
Merchants classified with this MCC provide professional services that are not classified with a more specific MCC.

titleEn: Court Costs, Including Alimony and Child Support
descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC are local, state, and federal courts of law that administer and process court fees, alimony, and child support payments.

Merchants classified with this MCC are government entities that administer and process local, state, and federal fines and penalties, motor vehicle violations, and community-or property-assessed fines.
Merchants classified with this MCC post bail to the court system as security for the appearance of the arraigned individual.

Merchants classified with this MCC are local, state, and federal entities that engage in financial administration and taxation including collection of taxes and penalties and custody and disbursement of funds.
Merchants classified with this MCC are government entities that provide general support services to government and communities are not classified with a more specific MCC.
Merchants classified with this MCC are government postal offices that provide a variety of services such as accepting and processing packages and mail for delivery and selling postage stamps.

titleEn: U.S. Federal Government Agencies or Departments
descriptionEn: Merchants classified with this MCC process U.S. federal government transactions using an acquiring BIN associated with the Intra-Government Transfers (IGOTS) program.
Merchants classified with this MCC are government-owned lotteries that sell lottery tickets.
This MCC is used only by Visa to enable members and processors to identify emergency transactions from the Global Customer Assistance Services (GCAS).
Merchants classified with this MCC process purchasing card transactions representing internal unit-to-unit transfers of goods and services.
